reviewer_instruction: Implement only the Chrome R6 M3 reviewable draft; do not modify M1/M2 or existing Fresh runtime. Add poc_v2/chrome_r6_synthetic/m3_registry.py, test_m3_registry.py and M3_REGISTRY.md. Create a strict deterministic append-only sealed WorkspaceMissionRegistry with an OS single-writer lock and exactly two immutable profiles. Bind each profile to canonical resolved worktree path, authorized repo huamuyin/codex-with-chatgpt, exact credential-free registered origin remote and distinct branch. Add a local Git snapshot helper using subprocess argv/no shell/no network for show-toplevel, origin, branch and HEAD. Mission start must freeze profile/mission/request/control/original_expected_commit and require initial HEAD equality; allow later workspace progress only through append-only checkpoint_recorded events while original_expected_commit remains immutable and is the only expected commit used for reply/retry identity. Enforce one active mission globally, globally unique request/control IDs, sequential attempts, exact profile/mission identity, duplicate native target and cross-profile rejection. Persist failure/uncertain/reply/action-receipt/closure audit. Restore must replay only and call no Git mutation, Chrome, observe, retry or send callback. Implement deterministic recovery decisions OBSERVE_EXISTING_ATTEMPT, EXPLICIT_RETRY or SAFE_BLOCK. Retry requires durable failed/uncertain state plus a separately persisted one-use retry_authorized event; claim_retry must append retry_started before yielding a directive with the same request/control/original commit and next attempt, and may never yield again after restore. Actual observation/retry remains through existing Fresh gates; store no token and do not bypass Host/Origin/component/tab/reply checks. Add the positive/negative, tamper, second-writer, current-HEAD-substitution, cross-profile and restore-no-send tests in this PLAN. After unit gates pass, run one bounded sanitized integration using exactly two synthetic worktrees/branches of this repo through the owned Chrome route: complete A, switch to B, prove no cross-profile target/reply acceptance and no implicit restore send. Run full Python/Node/syntax/manifest/diff gates. Commit only M3 synthetic source/docs/tests and PLAN evidence, then publish an evidence-only .c2c-v2/chrome-r6/m3/draft descriptor with exact implementation commit, source hashes, actual test/integration counts and explicit remaining independent-review obligations. Do not claim acceptance, access credentials/APIs, install, merge main, touch Edge/family-fund/old branch, or start any post-M3 work.
